task.title: The failed-intent withdrawal destroys unsaved form text, and its recorded rationale is stale
task.description:
withdrawFailedIntentFromOpenDetail (internal/webui/assets/index.html:1685-1692) calls renderRoute(), which rebuilds the detail form from latestTasks and silently discards everything typed since the form opened.

Failure scenario: a user opens task T's detail form over a pending board intent and types a long description. The intent fails a second later. The form is rebuilt, the typed description is gone, and an in-flight save is detached — a detached save reports nothing when it lands, so the user hears only that their board change failed.

The re-render cost is already recorded in the design doc at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-06-optimistic-web-mutation-queue-design.md (the "A failure with the detail form open" section, extended in commit 42c6081) and deferred to the render restructuring in WB-01KZC3PGA0QCXKDQ936VPM67D5. That downstream ticket is about keyed board reconciliation and does not currently mention the detail form, withdrawFailedIntentFromOpenDetail, or preserving unsaved text, so the deferral is recorded in prose but not carried by any ticket's scope. This ticket carries it.

Separately, the recorded justification no longer holds. Both the code comment and the doc justify the data loss with "it reads as saved state, and saving it would persist the refusal as a real edit." That stopped being true in the same PR that added changedTaskValues (index.html:1478-1489), which diffs the controls against the projected task the form rendered:

    if (controls.status.value && controls.status.value !== task.status) values.status = controls.status.value;

An untouched status control equals task.status, so the refused optimistic value is never placed in values and cannot be persisted. What the re-render actually buys is display accuracy — the form no longer shows a value the server rejected — traded against real data loss on a field the user was mid-edit in. That is a defensible trade but a different one than the one written down, and the rationale should be corrected alongside the fix.

Work: keep the typed edits and correct only the projected fields (and leave an in-flight save attached), then update the comment at index.html:1680-1684 and the doc paragraph to state the actual reason.

Deferred from PR #29 (merged as a2fd315) as a minor review finding.
